description: Source code for SHT3XD sensor driver trigger handling in Zephyr RTOS, including interrupt setup, trigger configuration, and alert handling.

methods.name: sht3xd_attr_set
methods.description: Sets threshold attributes for temperature and humidity sensors.

methods.name: setup_alert
methods.description: Configures GPIO interrupt for alert signals.

methods.name: handle_alert
methods.description: Handles alert event, disables alert, and triggers thread or callback.

methods.name: sht3xd_trigger_set
methods.description: Configures trigger for sensor alerts, including setting up GPIO and callback.

methods.name: sht3xd_gpio_callback
methods.description: GPIO callback invoked on alert signal, calls handle_alert.

methods.name: sht3xd_thread_cb
methods.description: Thread callback to invoke user handler and re-enable alert.

methods.name: sht3xd_thread
methods.description: Thread function for handling alerts in own thread context.

methods.name: sht3xd_work_cb
methods.description: Work handler for global thread trigger.

methods.name: sht3xd_init_interrupt
methods.description: Initializes GPIO interrupt and thresholds for alert handling.
